laws.rule: Davao City: smoking or vaping in prohibited areas or outside designated areas is fined ₱3,000 (about A$66.90 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) plus cessation counselling; in government offices ₱3,000 plus counselling and referral.
laws.heading: Davao City smoking and vaping

laws.rule: Mount Apo, Davao City side: in November 2024 the city reported DENR guidance that Barangay Tagurano contains strict-protection area where trekking was not authorised; it described limited exceptions for scientific research and Indigenous ceremonies. The article says a tourist trail would require reclassification. This is a dated report: ask DENR and the Protected Area Management Board about current zoning, permitted routes and any separate community consent before planning.

sources.title: DENR: No trekking in Tagurano
sources.authority: City Government of Davao, reporting DENR regional guidance
sources.supports: 2024 strict-protection zoning and trekking position, read directly; current zoning not independently checked
